notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content: [p]Hello, Hi. Hey. Bonjour! Guten Tag![/p][p]Update with some things up now.[/p][h3]⁉️ New Area[/h3][p]A mysterious building has appeared for a possible future mystery. Try and find it![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650595/b7d6ed4775b59799b6855f8e218a551927631add.png"][/img][/p][h3]💧 New Water[/h3][p]Updated the water shader, used screen position to make it less transparent from where you are looking.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650595/4c64b76645a32bff8329851afa5198d4eb88f81d.png"][/img][/p][h3]🔧 Fixes and Adjustments and Additions[/h3][list][*][p]Added a sound effect for the sliding automatic door.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed stick markers on the mini-map going under some trees.[/p][/*][*][p]Mini-map now shows slightly more distance.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the Start menu background graphics some.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some jagged parts on the ground.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🦆 Duck[/h3][p]Fixed [i]that[/i] duck walking under the terrain AND added a worn path under to show it's walked that loop non-stop for many years.  🦆 👻?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650595/38bf8507ff45fdde57611a88d79a1721549b8e01.png"][/img][/p][p]Ok that's it for this update.[/p]

notes.title: Finding Cool Sticks is Out Now!
notes.content: [p]Finding Cool Sticks is out now![/p][p][/p][p]There's different difficulty settings in the uh, settings menu. Stick highlights for more visible sticks or you can turn things off like maps to make it harder. It auto-saves every 10~ seconds.[/p][p][/p][p]If you want to leave feedback, tell which part/parts you liked/disliked and would want more of and/or be expanded upon:[/p][list][*][p]Exploring[/p][/*][*][p]Puzzles[/p][/*][*][p]Mini-games[/p][/*][*][p]Fighting Monsters[/p][/*][*][p]Stick Customization[/p][/*][*][p]Platforming (stick stats like jump and speed mattering more)[/p][/*][*][p]Other[/p][/*][/list][p]Can make more updates for these things. Can also make new and harder/easier monsters to fight? Have lots of ideas for things but need to know what stick enthusiasts want most in their cool stick game.[/p][p][/p][p]Also post your favorite stick, for example, this one is really cool:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650595/68b465ae03f553c984920263ae8e9b1a35b69de8.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650595/a794e581f710066623f56ab8f0a695ebd8045e60.png"][/img][/p][p]It's got a hilt and everything.[/p][p]Also kind of want to redo the game poster/art. Maybe like a pile of sticks or just a hand holding a stick.[/p]
